contributionMap.claim: Theorem 4.1: a three-node pair-sum system with A = 3I, observable from one epoch and controllable, whose IsoKF reported marginals satisfy m_k >= (5/4)(9/5)^k - 1/4 while every local block stays positive definite and the centralised Kalman filter stays <= 3/4; refutes the IsoKF convergence conjecture.

limitationTriage.limitation: Certified entry into the escape region is shown only at eight values of a^2; nothing is proved for a^2 in (1.38, 2+sqrt5).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can entry be certified uniformly on (1, 1.38] and can the gap (1.38, 2+sqrt5) be closed?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Certificates C1-C3 cover the stated values; a uniform entry argument was not found in the revision round.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Bounded actual estimation error and the divergence thresholds are numerical findings, not theorems.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the actual IsoKF error covariance provably bounded in the divergent cases?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: 80-digit exact linear recursion and an independent Decimal recursion agree (Finding 7.1).
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Uniqueness of the steady state for Schur-stable dynamics, and global behaviour at a = 1, remain open.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the IsoKF fixed point unique when A is Schur stable?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Proposition 3.1 proves boundedness only; stated as open question (iv).
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Certificates and exact checks could be silently disabled under python -O or accept a corrupted claim.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the verifiers fail when an expected value is wrong, including under python -O?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: All checks are explicit (no assert); a corrupted determinant makes verify_exact.py exit non-zero under -O (release gate negative control).

limitationTriage.limitation: Priority holds only within a bounded search.
